text: Union Bank lent two hundred and thirteen rupees for every hundred it raised.
Clue one. In a year, loans grew one lakh eighty thousand crore. Deposits grew just eighty five thousand crore.
Clue two. The deposits it skipped were the costly ones. Fixed deposits grew three percent. Cheap CASA grew fifteen.
The twist. Cheaper money, but not enough of it. The loan to deposit ratio jumped from seventy seven to eighty four percent.
Smart funding, thinner cushion. Can deposits catch up? Back to the napkin.
